mintAuthority.summary: WCOP has six reviewed independent native issuance deployments on Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Ripio's issuer EOA directly holds MINTER_ROLE on each deployment, the 4-of-7 Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and can regrant native roles, and the separate LimitedMinter contract is an additional Ethereum native minter facility. The LimitedMinterBridge burn/mint adapter is bridge machinery reviewed only under Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: The corrected Mint Authority scope is six independent native WCOP deployments: Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis each expose the verified LatamStable implementation and the issuer EOA's direct MINTER_ROLE; the 4-of-7 Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and can regrant native roles. The separate 0xd168cfbbe260d48cd119497a9a2ee8482080c5e7 LimitedMinter remains an Ethereum native minter facility with its own daily limit. The 0x46167cB034FeC6ceC46CaeD4f61281f5Aa0Eb0e6 LimitedMinterBridge is an issuer-operated cross-chain burn/mint adapter with rate-limit, pause, admin, and arbitrary-recipient mint surfaces; those facts are relocated to route-scoped Bridge Risk and are not counted as native Mint Authority. LatamStable.mint() has no intrinsic cap and its UUPS upgrade authorization has no timelock, so native issuance remains unbounded and immediately replaceable. Supervision remains attestation-only because the March 2026 CPA certification is ad hoc rather than a recurring prudential regime; reconciliation remains unknown.
